full:
Sihphir Presbyterian Kohhran chu Presbyterian Church of India hnuaia kohhran pakhat a ni a. Mizoram Presbyterian Kohhran hnuaiah an awm a, Sihphir village, Aizawl District-a an thleng a ni.

Kohhran hi a nei chu a nih — harsatna tam tak an hmachhawn a, Pathian fak leh biak dan an zir a nih. Missionary-te tanpuina nena, mipui te pawh dah ve taka Pathian biak dan te rawn lo kal a nih.

Tun dinhmun ah chuan kohhran hi a hmasawn hle a, member zat pawh a chungtla hle. Pathian fak leh biak dan an zir dan chuan ram leh hnam tan pawh hmasawnna a pe thei a nih.
